title: Profitable Yachts and Boats Business for Sale in Alexandroupoli, Greece
tagline: Yacht charter company based in Lefkada, Greece, operating weekly commercial sailing yacht charters in the Ionian Sea. - The business offers both bareboat and crewed charters for leisure clients. - The fleet consists of 2 fully owned and equipped Hanse sailing yachts: a Hanse 508 accommodating up to 12 guests and a Hanse 388 accommodating up to 7 guests. - Both yachts were purchased new and are equipped for commercial charter operations. - The company is managed by an external professional management company, allowing the owner to maintain an investment-oriented operating structure. - Historical and normalized financial data indicate an annual operating yield of approximately 8–10% based on an asking price of EUR 470,000. - Average normalized annual operating results are approximately EUR 48,000 before VAT. - Both yachts hold valid Certificates of General Inspection for commercial operations. - The business operates through a Greek Private Company (IKE) established approximately 6 years ago and is focused exclusively on weekly yacht chartering. - The company operates under the special tax regime of Law 27/1975, with the stated tax treatment subject to applicable statutory conditions.
